summary: Frontend-only testing of the new /admin/account (Account & Security) page for the founder. All acceptance criteria PASSED: login as founder@audinexa.com, admin-account-btn visible in sidebar bottom and navigates to /admin/account, compromise-panel (rose-tinted 3-step banner), change-password-card with 3 password inputs, active-sessions-card with 50 rows initially. Wrong-password path returned HTTP 401 and toast 'Current password is incorrect'. Single-session revoke removed the target row (50->48, one row plus refresh delta). Bulk 'Sign out other sessions' left the current session alive and reduced list to 1 (only current device). Regression: /admin, /admin/tenants, /admin/stuck-users all load correctly. No route/import regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: Change-password submit button on the compromise-recovery page becomes disabled while fields are empty — good UX; verified via screenshot.
'This device' badge correctly rendered for the current session; the bulk-revoke properly excludes it (session count reduced from 48 to 1).
seed_data_creation: None — used the pre-existing ~50 accumulated founder sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk-revoke reduced accumulated founder sessions to 1 (only current device). Next runs will see fresh session counts as more logins accumulate.
